description: Implementation of the NativeJS plugin for WPEFramework, managing JavaScript applications and rendering via NativeJSRenderer, including initialization, application lifecycle management, and thread handling.

classes.name: NativeJSImplementation
classes.description: Class implementing the native JavaScript application management for WPEFramework, handling initialization, application lifecycle, and rendering.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with a specified Wayland display, starting the rendering thread.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Stops the renderer and joins the rendering thread.

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a new JavaScript application with specified options.

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Runs a specified application with a given URL.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code in a specified application context.

methods.name: GetApplications
methods.description: Retrieves the list of current applications.
